title: Portfolio Website

listing.shortDescription: A modern, animated personal portfolio built with React 19, Vite and GSAP — glowing cards, magnetic buttons, particle backgrounds and micro-interactions throughout.
listing.fullDescription: A developer's personal portfolio is a portfolio page, a motion showcase and a brand statement all at once. Built with React 19, Vite and Tailwind CSS v4, this site layers GSAP-driven reveals, gradient text with flipping words, 3D tilt glow cards, a magnetic call-to-action button and a cursor follower — every scroll and hover is a deliberate micro-interaction.

cover.imageAlt: Portfolio Website — Animated Developer Portfolio with GSAP

features.title: Word-flip hero
features.description: Gradient text with flipping words that re-key the headline as you watch.

features.title: Split-text reveals
features.description: GSAP stagger animations reveal headings line by line on scroll.

features.title: 3D tilt glow cards
features.description: Project cards tilt toward the cursor with a spotlight that follows it.

features.title: Magnetic CTA
features.description: The call-to-action button pulls toward the cursor with a sheen sweep.

features.title: Cursor follower
features.description: A custom cursor overlay that scales over interactive elements.

features.title: Particle background
features.description: Canvas particles and floating decorative icons behind the hero.

challenge.summary: A portfolio has to prove its own hype. The site had to feel as polished as the work it showcases — and it had to load fast and stay accessible while doing it.

points.title: Performance budget
points.description: Heavy animation libraries can wreck load time on a showcase site.

points.title: Mobile-first motion
points.description: Effects that feel great on desktop must degrade gracefully on phones.

points.title: Content that sells
points.description: Projects, skills and services had to be presented in an order that convinces.

solution.summary: Every animation was built with a performance budget in mind — GPU-friendly transforms, scroll-triggered reveals and motion that enhances, never obstructs.

points.title: Layered reveals
points.description: GSAP split and stagger text reveals give the page a signature rhythm.

points.title: Spotlight cards
points.description: 3D tilt with a follow-the-cursor glow makes project cards tactile.

points.title: Micro-interactions
points.description: Magnetic buttons, cursor scaling and sheen effects reward every hover.

objectives: Prove the developer's motion and UI skills with the site itself
Keep every effect performant on mobile as well as desktop
Present projects, skills and services in a convincing order
Make the whole thing easy to update as the portfolio grows

closing.clientOverview: Personal project — the developer's own showcase site
closing.conclusion: The portfolio became a live, animated showcase that visitors remember — the developer's own site, rebuilt with the same motion and polish it sells to clients.
